description: Java source code for a Fragment that demonstrates the use of a custom SlidingTabLayout with a ViewPager, including setting up the adapter and page titles.

classes.name: SlidingTabsBasicFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that sets up a ViewPager with a SlidingTabLayout to display tabbed pages.

classes.name: SamplePagerAdapter
classes.description: A PagerAdapter that provides pages with titles and views for the ViewPager.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the ViewPager and SlidingTabLayout after the view is created.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Checks if a view is associated with a specific key object.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for each page, e.g., 'Item 1', 'Item 2', etc.

methods.name: instantiateItem
